entries.rationale: The installer runs before the TypeScript payload exists. It needs the same token renderer without importing compiled code.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: installer and compiled projection renderers stay byte-identical

entries.rationale: The installer must render policy rules before a compiled TypeScript payload exists.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: installer and compiled projection renderers stay byte-identical

entries.rationale: The two mutually exclusive reviewer roles need the same verdict boundary in their independent judgment guidance.
evidence: tests/unit/policies.test.ts: representative review contexts resolve distinct review policy sets

entries.rationale: Each independently invoked entry command must prevent nested supervision before it adopts the shared supervisor persona.
Only one installation-specific bootstrap rule is projected. Both variants must retain the same supervisor and retrieval invariants.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: self-development and embedded projection coverage

entries.rationale: Each language policy independently guards its formatter-owned appendix and can be delivered without the other policy.
Each generated language handbook must state its own bounded unknowns because agents read only guidance for relevant languages.
